changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS integration.payment_order ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), unique_id UUID NOT NULL, user_in TEXT NOT NULL, package_id UUID NOT NULL, amount DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, promo_code TEXT, provider TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now(), last_modified_date TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now(), version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payment_order_unique_status ON integration.payment_order (unique_id, status);
